As for the Battle of Manila, it was part of the Philippine campaign towards the end of the war. The liberation of Manila happened after Guam's recapture, so that lines up with Guam being earlier.

I think I've got it now. Guam was recaptured in 1944, and Manila was liberated in 1945. Therefore, the Battle of Guam occurred first.
